portion_doctrine: Segments 51-60 contain two podcast interview transcripts (Drink Champs): 21 Savage story arc (trauma, street life, music career, Drake/Metro relationships, album strategy, R&B influences) and Terry Crews (entertainment mindset, football-to-acting pivot, family resistance, LA startup mentality). Zero structural doctrine or actionable methods; pure conversational narrative. No boilerplate/ads stripped from 51-52, significant ad read from GameTime in seg_052 (lines 168-174) kept minimal. Remaining 8 segments are straight interview content—relationship advice, touring insights, streaming economics (minor: 7030 split with Epic, catalog future value), grilling cost ($85k), tattoo stories, fatherhood philosophy. No operating rules, no named methods, no numbers of strategic weight, no prompts. Mostly motivational-memoir content.
content_ideas: Reward cycles for young men of color: attention economy in street life vs legitimate paths (21 Savage on why dumb stuff gets rewarded early)
Private relationships vs public performance: relationship management doctrine (21 Savage on dating privately to break up privately, avoiding internet commentary toxicity)
Aspirational inspiration vs competitive jealousy in peer success: psychological frame for allies (21 Savage on looking at Drake as inspiration vs resentment)
Million-dollar mindset reframe: sweeping floors as if paid $1M (Terry Crews on shifting effort during downturn)
Spouse as accountability/reality check: Terry's wife called him on not studying plays enough, became proof he wasn't fully committed
Never-leaving commitment: Terry's vow to wife (never leaving LA, even at 99), as leverage against drift
contradictions: 21 Savage says 'people always been killing forever' (killing is inevitable) vs moments later frames killing as choice/revenge cascade (can choose to break cycle). Philosophical tension: determinism vs agency.
21 Savage on keeping relationships private (for control/privacy) vs Terry Crews on authenticity mattering in relationships (suggesting transparency matters). Different models of intimacy.
Terry frames NFL as 'means not end' (never liked football) but also credits football discipline as what taught him to study/practice—implying it WAS the training ground, not just a detour.
weird_gold: The term 'agulation' instead of 'exultation' in hype language (line 1:40:48-54, seg_052) - possible dialectal/slang pronunciation or transcription error worth checking
21 Savage's frame on sample clearance: cleared for album, not for commercials/TV (seg_053, lines 178-184). IP restriction creates sunken-cost trap: big song becomes unusable.

Terry's specific challenge to sweeping metaphor: 'imagine if you're almost in tears sweeping this floor because my life may never get back'—emotional realism in aspirational thinking (seg_060, line 13:15)
21 Savage: 'gifts don't cost anything, time does' paraphrase—values time over material as parenting currency, but earlier section shows he DID buy gifts for Drake/Thug. Action vs stated value gap.
Terry on being 11th round (glorified free agent): systemic ceiling was baked in before commitment. Effort ceiling determined by draft slot.
21 Savage on R&B Mount Rushmore list: Usher, SWV, Beyonce, Kilo Ali (singer), Monica. Not conventional (includes SWV as vocal group, Kilo Ali singular artist). Ears on the person, not the canon.
contradictions_detail: 21 Savage: 'my gun won't love you back, the block won't hug you back' (lines 190-196, seg_059)—moral message to younger men—yet his own entry to rap was AFTER getting shot, suggesting the message came from lived proof, not prior conviction.
